component.name: AI Reel Studio
component.summary: Professional Native AI-Powered Short-Form Video Production Studio

description.p: AI Reel Studio is a professional native Linux desktop application for creating, editing, previewing, and exporting short-form social videos (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok) and standard video formats.

ul.li: Multi-provider AI orchestration supporting Google Gemini, OpenRouter, and generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
Secure API credential management via the native Linux Secret Service API (GNOME Keyring / KWallet).
Procedural multi-track audio synthesis and background music generation.
Dynamic Ken Burns motion pan/zoom cinematography.
Automated word-level synchronized animated caption overlays.
Hardware-accelerated rendering and verified H.264 / AAC MP4 exports via FFmpeg.
Real-time preview and playback pipeline powered by GStreamer and GTK4.
Local SQLite project library and offline state persistence.

screenshot.caption: AI Reel Studio main workspace and storyboard editor

description.p: Initial production release of AI Reel Studio natively written in C17 and GTK4.
